title: Digital Social Work Practice
outcome: Use digital tools and digital service channels in ways that advance access, protect privacy, and preserve accountable human professional judgement.

modules.title: Digital inclusion and service design
modules.focus: digital exclusion, accessibility, participation, community co-design, device and connectivity constraints, and non-digital alternatives

modules.title: Information governance and secure practice
modules.focus: purpose limitation, informed consent, minimum necessary information, secure communication, records, retention, incident reporting, and local legal requirements

modules.title: Telepractice, AI, and professional accountability
modules.focus: role and boundary setting, suitability and risk checks, bias and error awareness, human review, transparency, documentation, supervision, and escalation
